loading_mode: Playwright set_content; isolated document. Public-origin checks are separate.

checks.name: Empty state prevents analysis and exports
Built-in media decodes and produces three actual selections
Selected-range playback advances real source media
Source trace highlights exact cues and filters text
Risky manual cut is flagged; extending it restores missing context
Changed ranking settings cannot silently export stale results
Browser exports a valid ZIP with matching SHA-256 and real captions
Individual subtitle download uses the clip-relative timeline
Malformed import is rejected without destroying the current project
Untrusted filename and transcript markup cannot execute HTML
390-pixel mobile layout has no horizontal overflow
Browser renderer produces a real portrait WebM with an audio track
Cancel stops recording and does not export a partial file
No external HTTP requests or uncaught browser errors

limitations: Desktop Chromium tested. Safari, Firefox, Windows Edge and mobile hardware were not exercised.
Checks are reproducible internal tests, not independent user validation.
